premises.text: Frequent blackouts leave households and businesses without predictable grid power
premises.evidence_span: 175 million Nigerians experience blackouts every day

premises.text: Backup generators cost about four times grid power and undercut revenue
premises.evidence_span: it costs four times the amount to run a backup generator than it costs to get power from the grid

premises.text: Low-cost Android phones in proprietary cases act as community power sensors
premises.evidence_span: we take low-cost Android phones, just like this, and we turn them into power sensors

premises.text: Users get push (or SMS) notifications when power is restored or taken and can report downed lines
premises.evidence_span: she'll get a push notification that the power has been restored

premises.text: Power companies are the main customers, using the platform to communicate with end users
premises.evidence_span: our main customers are the power companies, and they can use our platform to communicate directly with their customers

value.text: Real-time power outage notifications so people and utilities can adapt
value.evidence_span: We provide real-time power outage notifications

causal_links.evidence_span: imagine what businesses could adapt to with a little more predictability
let our users know when there's power available in their community

notes: Bill-pay/data-play roadmap folded out as non-conditions. 'Number one platform in Africa' vision excluded per §4.1(4). Pilot with Idibadan treated as traction evidence of utility channel, mechanism coded in P5. Singleton D3 justified as customer/channel module.
